title: Image fidelity question pilot
finding: Planned pilot before Experiment 43: 30 Experiment 33 pages (7 rf06/rf07 junk layers, 23 open-licence healthy), Clef-Flash Q8_0 plus mmproj on llama.cpp b11941 and a hosted TypeSafe Jev image control on healthy pages only; gates G1 (median P(yes) faithful minus wrong >= 0.5) and G2 (AUC faithful vs junk >= 0.9).
